description: This file defines the RenderableFtlString class, which implements the RenderableFtl interface. It encapsulates a string containing FreeMarker Template Language (FTL) content, provides methods for constructing instances via a builder pattern, and supports visitor pattern traversal.

classes.name: RenderableFtlString
classes.description: A final class representing an immutable FTL string object that implements RenderableFtl, with methods for creation, access, and accepting visitors.

classes.name: RenderableFtlString.RenderableFtlStringBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing RenderableFtlString instances, encapsulating a StringBuilder.

methods.name: RenderableFtlString
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a given FTL string.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Static method that returns a new RenderableFtlStringBuilder instance.

methods.name: withStringBuilder
methods.description: Creates a RenderableFtlString by applying a callback to a StringBuilder through the builder pattern.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString() to provide a string representation of the RenderableFtlString instance.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a RenderableFtlVisitor to perform operations on this RenderableFtlString.
